title: Uniform mean-curvature bound and monotonicity for varifolds stationary in N (Simon Ch. 4, 2.7 and 3.17)
statement: Let ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^{n+k} with (N̄ ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and y₀ ∈ N ∩ U. There exist r₀ > 0 and κ ≥ 0 with B̄_{3r₀}(y₀) ⊆ U such that, for every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) representing T with spt T ⊆ N and V = v(M, θ) stationary in U ∩ N (δV(X) = 0 for every C¹ vector field X with compact support, spt X ⊆ U and X(x) ∈ T_xN for all x ∈ N ∩ U), the following hold: (a) there is a μ_R-a.e. strongly measurable H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x and δV(X) = −∫⟨X, H⟩ dμ_R for every C¹ vector field X with compact support contained in B_{2r₀}(y₀); (b) for every z ∈ B_{r₀}(y₀) and 0 < σ ≤ ρ ≤ r₀, e^{κσ}σ^{−n}μ_R(B_σ(z)) ≤ e^{κρ}ρ^{−n}μ_R(B_ρ(z)). Here μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M, δV(X) = ∫_M θ div_M X dHⁿ (IMRep.firstVariation) with div_M X(x) = trace(P_{T_xM}∘DX(x)), T_xN is the classical tangent space (tangentSpace), and r₀, κ depend only on n, N, U, y₀.
